Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with .locked extension; Encrypts victim files and demands ransom; Used in ransomware attacks against organizations worldwide
Impacted Systems: High-profile targets such as Altran Technologies; Norsk Hydro; At least 1,800 organizations worldwide
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption; Use of master private keys accessed after operator arrest
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted with .locked extension; Ransom notes generated by LockerGoga ransomware
